note: Both classes are generated. Entries labelled not-fraudulent carry a generated persona and synthetic merchant and bank names just as the fraudulent ones do, so the label separates intent, not provenance. The pool contains no real consumer complaints.
tier_note: Capability tiers are ordinal. They are ranked, never treated as quantities, because error rates are not comparable across editions.
